summary.text: Justin Peroli is the Libertarian candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 66, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Libertarian primary.
A small business owner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a Lafayette Township trustee elected in 2023.

paragraphs.text: Justin Peroli earned a high school diploma from Cloverleaf High School, a bachelor's degree from Carnegie Mellon University in 2004 and a graduate degree from the University of Akron in 2007.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as small business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Peroli described himself as a Medina County resident who owns and operates an expedited freight brokerage serving customers across the country.
Peroli said in the survey that he was elected a Lafayette Township trustee in 2023 and has worked on financial controls and public access to records.
He said his key messages center on government transparency, stronger open records protections and greater financial oversight, and on limiting overspending and regulation.
